scope: Exploratory non-cancer application and limited cross-study culture-level replication; not independent-donor validation or full-audit superiority
outcome_exposure: The original study abstracts/results and published CRISPLD2 cross-study results were seen during R02 methods review.
No new Hallmark expression or replication outcomes were computed before preparing this protocol.
GSE34313 methods metadata and example intensities were inspected. These are not a wholly outcome-naive holdout.
candidate_collection: All 50 terms in the existing frozen human Hallmark gene-symbol snapshot; no new msigdbr download

discovery.source: Bioconductor airway::airway integer gene counts; STAR/Ensembl 75 re-quantification, not deposited FPKM or original Cuffdiff statistics
discovery.mapping: airway rowData gene_name snapshot; discard empty/multi-symbol annotations; sum integer counts for Ensembl rows mapping to the same single symbol
discovery.model: edgeR TMM; limma voom; paired ~ donor + treatment; treatmentdex coefficient; eBayes trend=FALSE robust=FALSE
discovery.stability: Remove each donor with BOTH samples, refit on the fixed full-discovery filtered genes. Four folds; missing/non-estimable folds count as non-replicated. Retain a discovery q<=0.05 term when at least 3/4 folds have q<=0.05 and the full-discovery NES sign. No threshold search.

validation.pairing: UNVERIFIED: fit unpaired culture-level groups; never infer donor/pair IDs from replicate suffixes
validation.source: Ten public raw single-channel Cy3 Agilent Feature Extraction files; preserve two exclusions made by the depositing study; add no sample exclusions
validation.normalization: limma read.maimages(source=agilent, green.only=TRUE), median foreground/background; normexp offset=50; quantile normalization across all ten public arrays; log2 returned by normalizeBetweenArrays(EListRaw); never guess or re-log deposited normalized values
validation.probe_filter: Raw ControlType==0; gIsWellAboveBG>0 in >=3/10 arrays; all normalized values finite; GPL6480 ID -> GENE_SYMBOL with single-symbol annotations only; aggregate all retained probes for a symbol by per-sample median
validation.model: Fit primary 24h dex (3) versus public controls (4) with unpaired ~ treatment, limma eBayes(trend=TRUE, robust=FALSE). Fit secondary 4h (3) versus the SAME controls (4) separately; secondary is not independent confirmation. No metadata-driven batch factor is authenticated.

gene_universe: Sorted intersection of full-discovery count-filtered single-symbol genes and mapped/filtered validation genes with positive variance across the ten arrays; freeze and export before DE fits. Keep this same universe for discovery, all donor folds, and both validation contrasts. Missing rank in any fit makes that fit's enrichment non-estimable rather than shrinking the universe.

enrichment.rank: Moderated t-statistic, descending; exact ties ordered by lexical gene symbol, with no random jitter
enrichment.multiplicity: BH adjustment across the fixed census of 50 terms (n=50), separately for each fit; retain out-of-size and numerical-failure terms as non-estimable records

endpoints.primary_replication: Validation 24h q<=0.05 and nonzero NES sign matching discovery; non-estimable terms are kept in each selected set's denominator and are not counted as replicated
endpoints.matched_q: Use K from Q_PLUS_DONOR_LOO_3_OF_4; select lowest discovery q, then lexical term ID. Never use validation outcomes for selection.
endpoints.report: All 50 term records, all four donor folds, selected IDs, denominators, coverage, same-direction counts, significant same-direction counts and descriptive stability-versus-matched-q difference
endpoints.uncertainty: One discovery study with 4 donor units and one validation cell line; overlapping Hallmark terms are not independent trials. No term-level binomial CI, p-value for superiority, or donor-generalization CI is computed.
endpoints.zero_selection: K=0 remains K=0 and replication rates are null; do not enlarge K or change thresholds
endpoints.claim_limit: These endpoints test statistical pathway replication and one audit component. They do not measure semantic correctness, novel biological discovery, full-audit performance, or expert agreement.

stop_rules: Changed frozen code, protocol, Hallmark snapshot, sample census, runtime identity or downloaded input hash: stop and preserve the first record.
Missing GPL6480 required fields, ambiguous file-to-sample identity, missing raw signal/background/detection fields: stop; do not switch normalization or source silently.
No paid or local model calls, no new expert packet, no ontology or gene endpoint selection from favorable observed outcomes.
An adverse result or zero selection is a result. Do not replace the dataset, time point, threshold or model to obtain a positive result.
